fusions.name: Sticky Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes out a long tongue that deals 7 damage, rising to 2 times that at maximum range. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Thunderous Plop
fusions.desc: Slams down in a burst of spray, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Sudden Spring
fusions.desc: You leap 6 tiles in the direction you face and gain +15% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Sprung Counter
fusions.desc: Every blow you avoid builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you strike the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (102% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher at all times.
